name: GeneralUser GS
description: The best-known lightweight GM/GS bank: 259 instrument presets and 11 drum kits under 30 MB of RAM, tuned for General MIDI playback and retro gaming. Distributed from the author's own site under a custom freeware licence, so this entry links to the download page instead of a direct file.
